spec.name: Orange Kitchen Chicken Ramen
spec.description: A stepped ivory ceramic bowl with a deep blue band, lowered rim and colorful chicken ramen: pale noodles in brown broth, two golden chicken pieces, a halved egg, green scallions and upright nori. Slim wooden chopsticks rest across the back.

prompt: Refine this existing ramen asset for stronger food readability and more appetizing color. The current bowl dominates and looks like brown wood. Make the bowl glazed ivory ceramic with a tasteful deep blue band and pixel highlights; reduce its rim height so the toppings are clearly visible from the inventory camera. The ramen surface should show several individual pale yellow noodle strips, warm brown broth, two pieces of golden chicken, an obvious half boiled egg with white and yellow yolk, bright green scallions and a dark nori garnish. Keep the nice stepped rounded bowl silhouette and slim wooden chopsticks. Repaint the single 64x64 atlas to match the new ivory/blue ceramic and colorful toppings; map and paint every visible face. Preserve high quality Minecraft vanilla pixel style, x/z0..16 and y0..9, no letters or scenery. This must read as a bowl of chicken ramen rather than a wooden container. Use the existing model as a starting point; change geometry and texture where needed.
